force/shock/bloom.name: Hoa nổ
force/shock/bloom.desc: an explosion shaped like a flower: rays rush in, a white flash, then three tiers of petals blast open with a shock ring, embers fly from the petal tips and the petals tear away from the empty centre

force/shock/drill.name: Khoan xoắn
force/shock/drill.desc: a spear of light inside a double helix that screws forward fast; the tip bites off small rings, sparks spiral off, then the coils unwind outward and the tip flies on alone

force/shock/shatter.name: Vòng vỡ
force/shock/shatter.desc: a thick ring slams in, overheats and cracks at eight points (two frames of glowing cracks), then bursts: the arcs tumble outward with hot fracture faces, chips fly from every crack and an energy ring escapes from the middle

force/shock/tiers.name: Tầng vòng
force/shock/tiers.desc: a hot flash at the contact, then three 3D rings born a frame apart along a bright axis streak; they shoot forward accelerating, overshoot, leave motion echoes and shed sparks from their tips

force/shock/vapor.name: Nón hơi
force/shock/vapor.desc: a sonic-boom pressure cone: a hot spearpoint pierces forward while three shells of compressed air peel back from it along flow lines; their mouths curl off into eddies and motes stream back
